verdict.rationale: Cerebras offers a Batch API for asynchronous processing of grouped requests and tool-calling/agent-loop capabilities that could be used to build autonomous agents, but there is no evidence of a built-in scheduler, trigger system, or persistent background-automation runtime that lets a user 'set up' automations to run unattended. missing for 10: scheduling/trigger infrastructure, persistent agent orchestration, first-party automation examples or docs describing background-running agents.
